title: 97¢ of every opposition dollar — animated donut
description: Looping animation: a donut chart sweeps from 0 to 97% with a live cent counter, showing that 97¢ of every dollar spent opposing Platner came through one super PAC — Pine Tree Results PAC, $10,723,548 of $11,077,173.
alt_text: Animation: a donut chart fills red from zero to 97 percent while a counter climbs to 97 cents, labeled “of every opposition dollar · one super PAC.” Ends: Pine Tree Results PAC, $10,723,548 of $11,077,173.
creator: Daniel Ismael Aguilar
usage_note: Data visualization compiled from public FEC filings and cited press reporting. Figures: $11,077,173 spent opposing Graham Platner vs. $323,426 supporting (FEC Schedule E, deduplicated, Oct 2025 – Jul 8, 2026).
accessibility_note: First frame shows an empty ring at 0¢; pair with a static PNG where a meaningful preview frame is required.
